svg.text: Models propose and argue. Plain code proves and blocks. A person holds the keys.

2 · Block · at the tool call · no model on this path
only Confirmed, pinned rules can block
Limits, stated: the hook is a speed bump, not a sandbox (CI is the floor) · repair is model-assisted and person-confirmed · receipts are tamper-evident, not tamper-proof · repo created Oct 26, 2026
separate path · runs after a local merge
